ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of golden-brown baked item with bubbly, slightly browned cheese-like topping on top edge, pale cream interior, sits at upper-left of plate, approx 9 cm long by 6 cm wide, about 2.5 cm thick, firm edges | 110
ITEM 2 | Mixed leafy greens: pale green crisp romaine-like lettuce pieces with wilted darker edges, lightly coated with creamy dressing, upper-center of plate, spread about 10 cm by 6 cm, moist and glossy | 90
ITEM 3 | Creamy white sauce or dressing blob, thick and opaque with flecks of herb, sits on top of lettuce at upper-right, about 6 cm by 4 cm, soft and spreadable, slightly glossy | 45
ITEM 4 | Small pieces of brownish-pink cooked meat chunk with crumb or seasoning, sits between lettuce and sauce at top center, about 3 cm by 2 cm, dry-looking surface | 15
ITEM 5 | Fresh green leaves (spinach-like and darker lettuce) with thin red onion rings, cherry tomato half, and dark olive-like pieces, lower-left of plate, spread about 9 cm by 8 cm, moist with light dressing sheen | 60
ITEM 6 | Sliced medium-rare meat, reddish-pink interior with browned crust edges, fibrous grain, juicy sheen, arranged in overlapping slices about 9 cm long and 2 cm thick, center-bottom of plate | 120
ITEM 7 | Roasted potato pieces with golden-brown crisp edges and pale fluffy interior, some with herb or seasoning flecks, right side of plate, four to five chunks about 3 to 4 cm each, dry surface | 110
ITEM 8 | Cauliflower or pale vegetable pieces with creamy yellow-white cheese-like sauce coating, right-lower side of plate, about 7 cm by 5 cm, soft and clumpy, slightly glossy | 80
